SELECT DISTINCT rr.category FROM user_cards uc JOIN reward_rules rr ON uc.card_id = rr.card_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND rr.reward_rate > 0.01 ORDER BY rr.reward_rate DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT cc.id as cardId, cc.name as cardName, cc.bank as bank, CASE WHEN cc.name LIKE '%Cash Back%' OR cc.name LIKE '%CashBack%' OR cc.name LIKE '%Momentum%' OR cc.name LIKE '%SimplyCash%' OR cc.name LIKE '%Dividend%' OR cc.name LIKE '%Money-Back%' THEN 'cashback' WHEN cc.name LIKE '%Aeroplan%' OR cc.name LIKE '%Avion%' OR cc.name LIKE '%Cobalt%' OR cc.name LIKE '%Aventura%' OR cc.name LIKE '%Scene%' OR cc.name LIKE '%Air Miles%' OR cc.name LIKE '%PC %' OR cc.name LIKE '%Optimum%' OR cc.name LIKE '%First Class%' OR cc.name LIKE '%Eclipse%' OR cc.name LIKE '%Gold Rewards%' OR cc.name LIKE '%Platinum Card%' THEN 'points' ELSE 'cashback' END as cardType, rr.category as category, rr.reward_rate as rewardRate, rr.monthly_cap_amount as monthlyCap, CASE WHEN cc.name LIKE '%Cash Back%' OR cc.name LIKE '%CashBack%' OR cc.name LIKE '%Momentum%' OR cc.name LIKE '%SimplyCash%' OR cc.name LIKE '%Dividend%' OR cc.name LIKE '%Money-Back%' THEN '%' ELSE 'x' END as rewardUnit FROM user_cards uc JOIN credit_cards cc ON uc.card_id = cc.id LEFT JOIN reward_rules rr ON cc.id = rr.card_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND (rr.reward_rate IS NULL OR rr.reward_rate >= 0.01) ORDER BY rr.reward_rate DESC

SELECT cc.id as cardId, cc.name as cardName, cc.bank as bank, CASE WHEN cc.name LIKE '%Cash Back%' OR cc.name LIKE '%CashBack%' OR cc.name LIKE '%Momentum%' OR cc.name LIKE '%SimplyCash%' OR cc.name LIKE '%Dividend%' OR cc.name LIKE '%Money-Back%' THEN 'cashback' ELSE 'points' END as cardType, rr.category as category, rr.reward_rate as rewardRate, rr.monthly_cap_amount as monthlyCap, CASE WHEN cc.name LIKE '%Cash Back%' OR cc.name LIKE '%CashBack%' OR cc.name LIKE '%Momentum%' OR cc.name LIKE '%SimplyCash%' OR cc.name LIKE '%Dividend%' OR cc.name LIKE '%Money-Back%' THEN '%' ELSE 'x' END as rewardUnit FROM user_cards uc JOIN credit_cards cc ON uc.card_id = cc.id JOIN reward_rules rr ON cc.id = rr.card_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND LOWER(rr.category) = LOWER(#{category}) ORDER BY rr.reward_rate DESC LIMIT 1
